features.how_it_works: Instruments, never product: (1) `ko-verify.mjs` runs every static suite plus the ledger, census, artifact and revival gates and writes `_evidence/ko-verify-latest.md`; (2) `ko-census.mjs` parses the three product scripts and refuses growth of decisions that return with no log row; (3) `ko-adlog-verdict.mjs` / `ko-adlog-window.mjs` read the extension's own ring (`ko.adlog`) and print per-page-load verdicts (ON SCREEN, FROZEN, JUMPS, SOUND, POD FREEZE, DISPLAY, REPEATS, HOLD EXPIRY, RELOADS, BUILDS IN THIS RING); (4) `ko-snapshot.mjs` reads the attributes the page publishes without touching the tab; (5) `ko-harness.mjs` drives a guest Chrome (port 9446, marker `G:/Temp/ko-harness/guest.json`) for kickparity/muteauthor/parity; (6) `ko-replica/` is an offline, deterministic Twitch watch page + ad delivery (HTTPS with a self-signed cert, HLS playlists served with a sliding ad window, a player worker, the real ad DOM shapes) so a pod can be replayed without a live stream; (7) `ko-load-check.mjs` is the pre-flight ceiling reading; (8) `ko-real-capture.mjs` + `ko-replica/compare.mjs` diff a real capture against the replica.
inputs: the repository working tree and its git history
the extension's ring dump (`chrome.storage.local['ko.adlog']`) read over CDP
a guest Chrome on port 9446 with the unpacked extension loaded, or the owner's Chrome on 9222 for read-only probes
replica scenarios (`_tools/ko-replica/scenarios/*.json`) plus generated media under `G:/Temp/ko-replica/media`
outputs: machine artifacts per verified bug (`_evidence/<bug>-arms.md`) and reachability records
verdict lines on stdout (`RESULT PASS|FAIL ... checks=N failed=0`) that a lane quotes as evidence

features.how_it_works: Three worlds, one page. The ISOLATED content script (`content.js`) mounts the kick/YouTube layer in an iframe (`player.html`), arbitrates ownership of the screen (`data-ko-owner`, `overlayOwnsPicture`, `OWNER_GRACE_MS`), pauses/resumes the page's own `<video>` through the stall watchdog (`nativeStallWatch`, which refuses with a named row), publishes the display clock verdicts (LIVE/BEHIND/REPEAT/FROZEN/PAUSED), sets the toolbar badge (`setBadge` -> `chrome.action`) and heals a stale tab only while it is hidden. `ko-audio.js` is the single writer of mute/volume (intent x policy x visible surface), persisted per tab in sessionStorage. The MAIN-world ad path (`twitch-adblock.js`) detects an ad by paint + slate text + the worker-hooked playlist, opens a pod, mints a clean source over Twitch's GQL usher, covers the native with the clean picture only once it is decoding at the sync target (`cleanLatTarget`, reveal waits for the caught-up report), freezes the page element for the pod's duration, and hands back exactly once (timeline-reset detection, buffered-edge or wall-clock target, `handback-wait` until `rs >= 3` or 3 s). `adblock-bridge.js` crosses the world boundary in both directions; `background.js` installs the DNR rules and the packaged resources (it holds no storage record and no badge).
inputs: the Twitch watch page DOM: `[data-a-target="video-player"]`, the squeezeback/slate ad text, the page's own `HTMLVideoElement`
Twitch's HLS playlists as fetched by the page's own player worker (token, `adExtinf`, `#EXT-X-DATERANGE`) and the GQL usher (`playbackAccessToken`)
real user gestures: pointer/key input on the page, the overlay bar, the popup (each carries an author stamp)
`chrome.storage.local` records (`ko.v2`), per-tab `sessionStorage` (`ko.audio.v2`), and the server-space preference
outputs: the overlay iframe + bar (`#ko-wrap`, `#ko-g1`, seek bar) with the kick/YouTube picture

features.how_it_works: `scripts/gate.py` is the repo-owned fast gate named in `revival/COMMANDS.md:14`: one stdlib Python driver that runs the repo's own instruments (JS syntax checks, `ko-census --gate`, the two product suites and the gate's selftests) with explicit per-stage timeouts and a named verdict per stage. `--json` prints one object, `--stage <name>` runs one stage, and the minute-scale `ko_verify` stage is opt-in so the driver can never become a second heavy job.
outputs: one verdict object (`--json`) or per-stage PASS/FAIL lines
rc 0 all PASS, 2 a named FAIL, 3 CANNOT-MEASURE/SKIPPED
